question_text: Pointing to a man, a woman said, "He is the son of my mother's only son." The man is her:
explanation: Her mother's only son is her brother; his son is her nephew.

question_text: A is the sister of B. C is B's mother. D is C's father. How is A related to D?
explanation: C is B's mother and D is C's father, so D is the grandfather of both A and B; A is D's granddaughter.

question_text: Ali, pointing to a photo, says, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." The photo is of Ali's:
explanation: His mother is Ali's mother's only daughter, i.e. Ali's sister; her son is Ali's nephew.

question_text: Father's only brother's daughter is your:
explanation: Your father's brother's daughter is your cousin.

question_text: P is the mother of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. How is P related to S?
explanation: P is the mother of both Q and R; S is R's child, so P is S's grandmother.

question_text: A man walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, turns right again and walks 5 km. Where is he from the start?
explanation: 5 km north, 3 km east, 5 km south: he is 3 km east of the starting point.

question_text: In the morning a man stands with his back to the sun. His shadow points towards:
explanation: In the morning the sun is in the east. Back to the sun means facing west, so the shadow falls to the west.

question_text: A man walks 20 m west, 10 m south, then 20 m east. He is now:
explanation: 20 m west and 20 m east cancel out; he is left 10 m south of the start.

question_text: A man faces south, turns left 90°, then turns right 180°. He now faces:
explanation: Facing south, left is east; then a 180° turn makes him face west.

question_text: Zahid walks 12 m north then 5 m east. His distance from the start is:
explanation: By Pythagoras: √(12² + 5²) = √169 = 13 m.

question_text: All soldiers are brave. Some brave people are young. Conclusions: I. Some soldiers are young. II. All brave people are soldiers.
explanation: 'Some brave are young' does not link soldiers to young people, and 'all soldiers are brave' does not mean all brave are soldiers; neither follows.

question_text: All cadets are disciplined. Ali is a cadet. Therefore:
explanation: All cadets are disciplined and Ali is a cadet, so Ali is disciplined.

question_text: In a row of 40 students, Ahmed is 15th from the left. His position from the right is:
explanation: Position from the right = 40 − 15 + 1 = 26.

question_text: Ali is taller than Bilal. Bilal is taller than Chaudhry. Danish is shorter than Chaudhry. Who is the shortest?
explanation: Order: Ali > Bilal > Chaudhry > Danish, so Danish is the shortest.

question_text: The angle between the hands of a clock at 3:30 is:
explanation: At 3:30 the hour hand is at 105° and the minute hand at 180°: difference 75°.

question_text: If the day before yesterday was Monday, the day after tomorrow will be:
explanation: The day before yesterday was Monday, so today is Wednesday; the day after tomorrow is Friday.

question_text: The arrow turns by a larger angle each time. Which comes next?
explanation: – The turn grows each step: +45°, +90°, then +135°. Directions are 0°, 45°, 135°, so the next is 135° + 135° = 270° clockwise from up, an arrow pointing left.

question_text: Figure 1 is related to Figure 2 in the same way as Figure 3 is related to which option?

explanation: – The inner "+" turns 45° into "×", while the outer shape stays the same. So the circle keeps its outline and gets "×".

explanation: – Row 1 has square outer shapes, row 2 circles, row 3 triangles. Columns carry inner circle, square, triangle. So the missing figure is a triangle containing a small triangle.

explanation: – Within each row the arrow turns 90° clockwise per column; row 3 goes down, left, then up.

question_text: A square sheet is folded once as shown and one hole is punched. Which figure shows the sheet when unfolded?
explanation: One vertical fold makes the hole appear twice, mirrored left-right across the fold line: at the same height on the right side.

question_text: A square sheet is folded once as shown and one hole is punched. Which figure shows the sheet when unfolded?
explanation: A horizontal fold mirrors the hole top-bottom across the fold: same left-right position, mirrored height.

question_text: A square sheet is folded twice as shown and one hole is punched. Which figure shows the sheet when unfolded?
explanation: Two folds give four layers, so 4 holes: unfold the last fold (mirror top-bottom) and then the first fold (mirror left-right).

question_text: A square sheet is folded twice as shown and one hole is punched. Which figure shows the sheet when unfolded?
explanation: Reverse the folds: mirror across the horizontal fold line, then across the vertical one, giving four holes forming a rectangle symmetric about the centre.

question_text: A square sheet is folded along its diagonal as shown and one hole is punched. Which figure shows the sheet when unfolded?
explanation: A diagonal fold mirrors the hole across the diagonal: the point (x, y) goes to (y, x), so the second hole appears on the other side of the diagonal at the swapped position.

question_text: The mirror is placed on the right of the letter (thick line). Which option shows its mirror image?
explanation: A mirror on the side flips the figure left-to-right (lateral inversion). Up-down is unchanged; the stem of the F stays on the right side.

question_text: The figure stands above a water surface (thick line). Which option shows its water image?
explanation: Water reflection flips the figure top-to-bottom; left and right stay the same.

question_text: A mirror is placed on the right of this clock showing 4:20 (hour hand short, minute hand long). What time does the mirror image show?
explanation: – Mirror time = 11:60 − actual time = 11:60 − 4:20 = 7:40.

question_text: Which option shows the water image of this letter?
explanation: The water image turns the letter upside-down (top-bottom flip), but left-right is not reversed.

question_text: The mirror is placed on the right of the digit. Which option shows its mirror image?
explanation: The mirror image is reversed left-to-right.

question_text: When this net is folded into a cube, which symbol is opposite to ■?

question_text: When this net is folded into a cube, which symbol is opposite to ●?
explanation: – Fold the net into a cube. Faces that are separated by exactly one face in a straight row are opposite, and the folding shows that ● lies opposite ★.

question_text: When this net is folded into a cube, which symbol is opposite to ▲?
explanation: – Fold the net into a cube. Faces that are separated by exactly one face in a straight row are opposite, and the folding shows that ▲ lies opposite ★.

question_text: Two positions of the same die are shown. Which number is on the face opposite to 3?
explanation: – The top face 1 is the same in both positions, so the die was turned about a vertical axis. The face 2 moved from the left side to the right side, so the face that was hidden at the back-left (opposite 3) came to the front-left: it is 4. So 4 is opposite 3.

explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days. PMA Long Course 159 – Mock Test | Page 31

question_text: The Pakistan Resolution was passed in:
explanation: The Lahore (Pakistan) Resolution was passed on 23 March 1940.

question_text: Which Article of the 1973 Constitution declares Islam the state religion?
explanation: Article 2 of the 1973 Constitution says Islam shall be the State religion of Pakistan.

question_text: The Lucknow Pact between Congress and Muslim League was signed in:
explanation: The Lucknow Pact (1916) was a Congress–Muslim League agreement.

question_text: Quaid-e-Azam presented his Fourteen Points in:

question_text: The approximate area of Pakistan is:

question_text: The longest river of Pakistan is:
explanation: The Indus (about 3,000+ km) is the longest river of Pakistan.

explanation: The Khyber Pass links Peshawar (Pakistan) with Jalalabad (Afghanistan).

question_text: The largest province of Pakistan by area is:
explanation: Balochistan is the largest province by area, roughly 44% of the country.

question_text: The Cabinet Mission Plan was announced in:

question_text: The 3 June 1947 Plan is also known as the:

question_text: The Tashkent Declaration was signed in:

question_text: The first Governor-General of Pakistan was:

question_text: The first Prime Minister of Pakistan was:

question_text: Pakistan conducted its nuclear tests at Chagai in:
explanation: Pakistan carried out its nuclear tests at Chagai on 28 May 1998.

question_text: SI unit of force:

question_text: Speed of light in vacuum:

question_text: Acceleration due to gravity on Earth (approx.):
explanation: Acceleration due to gravity on Earth is about 9.8 m/s².

explanation: A vector has both magnitude and direction; velocity is a vector, the others are scalars.

question_text: Rocket propulsion is explained by Newton's:
explanation: The rocket pushes gases backwards; the gases push the rocket forwards (action–reaction), Newton's third law.

explanation: Frequency = 1/T = 1/0.02 = 50 Hz.

question_text: Neither of the boys ___ present.

option_a: He said that he is tired
option_b: He said that he was tired

option_d: He said that he had tired

explanation: 'A piece of cake' means something very easy.

question_text: I look forward ___ meeting you.

question_text: One word for "fear of closed spaces":

question_text: He has no objection ___ the plan.

question_text: The largest city of Pakistan:
explanation: Karachi is the largest city of Pakistan by population.

question_text: The national language of Pakistan:
explanation: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan (English is the official language alongside it).

question_text: The smallest province of Pakistan by area:
